firm_data.firm_description: Johnson Van Kwawegen LLP is a trial-ready investor rights firm representing institutional investors in high-stakes securities and corporate governance litigation. The firm’s attorneys have secured over $4 billion in recoveries for investors and played central roles in some of the most consequential governance disputes in history.
notable_facts: Offices in New York, Delaware, and California
Combines governance expertise with trial capability
Represents asset managers, public pension funds, sovereign wealth funds, whistleblowers and individual investors

email.subject: AI for Johnson Van Kwawegen LLP, built for trial-ready investor rights firms
email.body:
Hi Jeroen,

Your team's work in shareholder and securities litigation, especially across three jurisdictions while maintaining trial readiness, requires the kind of precision and efficiency that most legal tech simply doesn't deliver.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in LA to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office on Thursday, April 10 to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
